nodes.text:
Marshal Corrin. Yes - the same rank as the thing in the trench.

Orun held it before me. He still answers to it, in his way, which is why I'd rather you didn't use it too loudly near the water.

He's still doing the job. That's the horror of it - he patrols his route, he relieves his sentries, he turns back anything that doesn't belong.

We don't belong any more. So he turns us back. There's no malice in it at all, and I'd sleep better if there were.

Singing. Under everything, all the time, if you hold still long enough to notice.

The cantors and the liturgists are all singing the same thing, and none of them started it. Something down there is keeping time. I send people to count, not to fight.
